items.headline: Barnett throws 3 of his 4 TD passes to Derry, UCF beats Iowa State to become bowl eligible
items.description: — Alonza Barnett III threw three of his four touchdown passes to Josh Derry and added a 15-yard rushing touchdown to help UCF beat Iowa State 48-17 on Friday night to become bowl eligible.
